digest.component_or_area: plan-review clarity measure and deterministic floor
propositions: Current clarity checks (generic H2 heading points, length thresholds, dash bullets) are duplicated in gates.py and det_floor.py and reward volume over adherence to author-guide leaf/container contract
Clarity measure lacks deterministic validation that plans contain required sections (Context/Problem, Scope/Approach for leaves, child decomposition for containers) with nonblank content
Per-AC verification coverage is not mechanically checked; each checkbox item should require operator-attested marking or explicit proving clause to be counted toward completion
Placeholder language (TBD, figure out, verify whether, depends on investigation) in Scope/Approach is not detected deterministically despite being explicit defer-signals in author guidance
Author guide and test expectations conflict on Success Criteria vs Acceptance Criteria and on rejected-alternative requirement, creating ambiguity in what clarity should enforce
Testing section shape (happy-path and failure-path markers) cannot be validated deterministically because applicability depends on ticket type and behavior testability
